title: Docket
subtitle: The self-serve guide to Legend of Toys' org-wide task manager: capturing, owning and tracking work across every department.

mem.label: Member
mem.name: Member (everyone)
mem.desc: Any signed-in LOT person. Creates tasks, and sees their own work, anything they collaborate on, and their own department's tasks. Edits the tasks they own or created.

view.label: Reviewer
view.name: Reviewer
view.desc: Sees every task across the whole organisation, read-only, plus the review Dashboard. A reviewer watches but does not change other people's tasks.

adm.label: Admin
adm.name: Admin
adm.desc: Full control: sees and edits any task, manages who has which role, and runs the admin screens (roles, users, spaces, dashboard sharing).

parts.subtitle: What Docket is, how to sign in, find your way around, and what your role lets you see.
Capturing work, the task list, the detail panel, and how a task lives from first idea to done.
The two ways to group tasks: Programs (a soft label) and Spaces (a private, walled-off area).
Your own private notebook with a built-in calculator.
The org-wide review surface, and how to share it.
Roles, who has which role, dashboard sharing, and the space registry. Admins only.
